description: The first RMAF MiG-29N converted into a gate-guard monument. Removed from RMAF Kuantan Air Base and moved by road on 4 January 2024 to the Joint Force Command headquarters at Sungai Panching, roughly 5 km from the air base; also described in Malaysian reporting as Al-Sultan Abdullah Camp. Coordinates given are the Sungai Panching locality centroid, not a surveyed position for the airframe.
museum_name: Joint Force Headquarters Kuantan MiG-29N Monument
